title: Bulgarian Government Scholarships under Bilateral Agreements
provider: Bulgarian Ministry of Education and Science
description: Scholarships for citizens of countries with an educational cooperation agreement with Bulgaria to undertake bachelor's, master's or doctoral study at Bulgarian state universities, taught in Bulgarian following a preparatory language year.
amount: Tuition-free place, monthly stipend and accommodation in a student hall

title: Scholarships for Students of Bulgarian Origin Abroad
provider: Bulgarian Ministry of Education and Science
description: Dedicated places and scholarships for people of Bulgarian origin living abroad to study at Bulgarian state universities under a simplified admission procedure.
amount: Tuition-free place and a monthly stipend for eligible students

title: American University in Bulgaria Financial Aid
field: Liberal arts (business, computer science, economics, political science, journalism)
description: Need- and merit-based financial aid for international undergraduate students at AUBG, a US-accredited liberal arts institution, covering a substantial share of tuition and, for some, living costs.
amount: Partial to near-full tuition, awarded on demonstrated need and academic merit

title: Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters (Bulgaria-hosted programmes)
description: Fully funded, integrated master's programmes run by a consortium of universities across at least three countries, some coordinated by or including Bulgarian institutions. Students apply to the individual programme consortium.
amount: EUR 1,400 per month, full tuition, insurance and travel/installation allowances

deadlines.term: 2027 intake (deadline varies by programme, Oct 2026 - Jan 2027)
